content:
It took me several episodes to get into Severance. Now I’m ALL in. I watch so few shows. I see far fewer movies (that I actually want to see). I watched episode 7 of season 2 this week and it was an absolute jaw-on-the-floor stunner. One of the aspects that really caught my attention was the WoeMeter. And then I discovered that Make3 posted a whole behind-the-scenes thing on it.

I don’t think seeing this will spoil much, but if you haven’t watched the show, but intend to do so, maybe just bookmark the page, add it to your reminders and move on.
